- Turning pages like the real thing!

- You can also check the score for each game in the match result table!

■ How to use
1. Select the match you want to play from 3 games, 5 games and 7 games.
2. Enter the player name, determine the right to serve and start the match.
3. Tap the bottom of the score panel to count up.
4. If you make a mistake, tap the top of the score panel with a “double tap” to return the score.
5. When the game is over, make a change end and start the next game.
6. When the match is over, the match result will be displayed. Match results can also be displayed from the menu.
7. If you want to play the same match again, you can reset it from the menu.
8. If you want to play a new match, go to the menu.
9. If you want to turn off the voice of the score, do it from the menu.
